categories.main_business_segments: Haidilao International Holding Ltd. primarily operates in restaurant operation focusing on hot pot cuisine, delivery business, sales of condiment products and food ingredients, and franchise business. The Group also incubates and develops new catering brands under the 'Pomegranate plan' to diversify its offerings and expand into various dining scenarios.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes continuous development of new menu items, soup bases, and dipping sauces, customizing menus to different taste preferences. It leverages digital operations and AI-powered post-meal evaluation systems to enhance management efficiency and customer experience. The Group also uses proprietary formulae for its condiment products supplied through its affiliated Yihai Group.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haidilao serves a broad customer base primarily in the Greater China region, including mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Its customers range from individual diners to corporate clients, with specialized restaurant formats such as family-oriented, late-night snack, and enterprise restaurants catering to diverse consumption scenarios.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates predominantly in mainland China with 1,332 self-operated restaurants, and also has presence in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Japan, and Singapore. It has a total of 1,368 Haidilao brand restaurants and additional outlets under its secondary brands across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haidilao operates primarily downstream in the supply chain as a restaurant operator and food service provider. It also engages in midstream activities through the production and sale of condiment products and food ingredients via its affiliated companies, supporting its restaurant operations and retail sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic priorities include enhancing customer dining experience, expanding diversified business through the 'Pomegranate plan', exploring franchise models, and pursuing strategic acquisitions. It focuses on innovation in service, menu customization, digital transformation, and incubation of new brands to drive sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Haidilao generates revenue mainly from restaurant operations (94.5% of total revenue), delivery services, sales of condiment products and food ingredients, and franchise fees. Revenue is recognized both at a point in time (restaurant sales) and over time (franchise business).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haidilao is a globally leading Chinese hot pot restaurant brand, recognized for its differentiated customer service and innovative dining experiences. While specific competitors are not named, the company faces intense competition in the catering industry and actively innovates to maintain its market leadership and brand appeal.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, Haidilao reported total revenue of RMB42.75 billion, a 3.1% increase year-on-year, with a core operating profit of RMB6.23 billion, up 18.7%. The Group operated 1,368 restaurants and served 415 million customer visits, reflecting steady growth and expansion in both scale and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haidilao emphasizes superior customer satisfaction through high-quality, diversified, and innovative menu offerings tailored to local tastes. It differentiates itself with exceptional service, flexible restaurant management allowing localized customization, themed dining experiences, and a strong digital engagement platform including a large membership base with exclusive privileges.
